title: Contrast
description: Two runs and the single named difference between them: the same content, the same seed, the same hero asked about the same contract, differing in exactly one field a player can perceive changing. ContrastDefinition.Load/.Parse enforce the same rules this schema states.

schema_version.description: Version of this contrast format. Pinned by const so a contrast authored for a later format is refused by tooling, not read under today's assumptions; ContrastDefinition.SupportedContrastSchemaVersion states the same number.

contrast.description: Stable name of this contrast; must equal the stem of the file holding it (e.g. payment_raised.json declares "payment_raised").

content_root.description: Repository-relative directory both branches load their content from — the production content/ tree, or a fixture tree for a case production content cannot reach.

seed.description: The one campaign seed both branches are built with.

hero.description: Content id of the hero definition both branches ask the same question of.

contract.description: Content id of the contract definition the vary is applied to and the hero is asked about.

vary.description: The one input that differs between the two branches, and its two values.

input.description: The only conditions a player can perceive changing. Closed rather than open: any field ContractState/HeroState carries could technically be varied, but only these eight are things a player at the table could have noticed. Renamed from contract.payment (Task 3's rename of the field everywhere else) and widened by DEC-008's negotiation slice: a flat contract.payment became a composed offer.advance/offer.method_tag/offer.promised_bonus, and a hero's grievance and belief in the guild's word joined as inputs. contract.accepted_by — a pre-state difference in who has already accepted, not a content field — was dropped rather than renamed; the property it demonstrated is pinned at the unit level instead (contract-decision-rule.test.ts).

from.description: The value the first branch carries for this input before the hero is asked. An integer for contract.patron_fee/contract.risk/offer.advance/offer.promised_bonus/hero.grievance, an array of content ids for contract.tags, a content id or null for offer.method_tag, a boolean for hero.believes_guild_promises.

to.description: The value the second branch carries for the same input. Must differ from 'from' — a contrast with nothing to compare proves nothing.

expect.description: The direction the hero's answer is declared to flip, from the 'from' branch to the 'to' branch.
